stem:
Read these sentences from paragraph 7.

There is a social element to solo sports as well. Chatting in the swim lanes at the public pool or meeting up with friends at the skate park creates opportunities for social interaction.

What is the best paraphrase of these sentences?

options.label: A
options.text: Swimming and skateboarding are both individual sports that offer the opportunity for social interaction, such as chatting with friends.

options.label: B
options.text: Individual sports provide opportunities to socialize, such as chatting in pool swim lanes and meeting friends at the skate park.

options.label: C
options.text: Social interactions that can occur during individual sports include meeting friends at the public pool or the skate park.

options.label: D
options.text: People can have social interactions while engaged in individual sports, whether they are swimming or skating.
